notes.title: Minor bug correction.
notes.notes: Just a few bugs corrected. Hope all are working fine now.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[b]The full release is here.[/b]

The final game is here. I feel sorry about the delay. There will be some minor updates, but the game is ready. Hope you have fun and like the update.

It will come out from early access in the next week.

notes.title: Pre Final Release Update.
notes.notes:
The final build is finally here. This is the last update and almost all new content is here. Just for a final test before go into full release.

New pursuits, mechanics, visuals, some UI, and several bugs fixed. Almost full-controller support, will be full in the final build. 

I am sorry for the 4 years of waiting but here it is. 

I am working in a new game and it is looking quite promising, called Nuclear Crawler. News soon.

notes.title: Final build will be released Feb 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630008/f8e88279bd9dc1408f75dc12a13e5ef66eb71526.jpg[/img]


The final release is coming. Will be released in Feb 2024. After many years and many personal problems it is getting done.

New game play, controllers support and many things.

notes.title: Early Access Released.
notes.notes:
The game is released, finally and with few levels, as it is in Early Access, every week will update new levels and new features. 

You can also free fly and collect points on your own. The leader board is also working.

Please work with us in the Steam discussion forum to improve the game. 

Thanks.

notes.title: Early Access release changed to September 4th.
notes.notes:
Several improvements and modifications caused some delays.

September 4th will be released a stable version of the game.

Several graphics changed so I will have to update the screenshots soon. 

Sorry guys. But it will be better.
